title: Concept: Third-party action referenced by a mutable tag in gha — review required
description: In gha, an action is referenced by a mutable tag. Tags are ordinary git refs and the upstream repository can repoint them at any commit, which means the code that runs in your pipeline is not the code you reviewed. Digest pins make the executed object immutable and auditable.
applicability: gha workflows that call third-party actions.
risk: Execution of substituted third-party code with workflow credentials; MEDIUM severity.
